source_issues.title: Generalization and blanket claims
source_issues.detail: Train score alone is not unseen-data evaluation but does not prove memorization. Holdout estimates depend on representative sampling and distribution; neither holdout nor sound evaluation guarantees arbitrary production performance.

source_issues.title: Splits and CV assumptions
source_issues.detail: Coherent ratios, finite rounding, time/group separation and dependence matter. Label stratification alone is insufficient for temporal or grouped observations. CV is not always more stable than every holdout. Source single-use test principle preserved.

source_issues.title: Fold remainder and validation errors
source_issues.detail: kfold(12,5) gives validation sizes[2,2,2,2,4]. Stratified8majority/2minority,k5 gives sizes[1,1,1,1,6] and minority[0,0,0,0,2], contrary to approximate class-ratio aim. k>n/zero k/ratios/shapes not validated; random.seed mutates global state.

source_issues.title: Confusion metrics scope
source_issues.detail: Single fixed confusion matrix does not yield every ROC or regression metric. Metric choice depends on costs/prevalence, not clinical/fraud labels alone. Functions assume0/1; zip silently truncates unequal inputs. accuracy([2,2],[2,0])=0 and accuracy([0,1],[0])=1 reproduced. Empty denominator0 is a convention.

source_issues.title: ROC/AUC missing origin and range
source_issues.detail: roc_curve omits threshold above maximum and initial(0,0). Labels[0,1],scores[.5,.5] give only(1,1) and AUC0 instead of tied ranking0.5. Perfect ranking1 and reverse ranking0 demonstrated; source0.5–1 term-table range wrong. One-class ROC and AUC0.5 interpretation require conditions.

source_issues.title: Regression metric boundaries
source_issues.detail: R2 variance-explained interpretation has conditions. Zero baseline refers to evaluation-set mean; demo uses training mean and obtains negative baseline. Constant perfect target returns0. Empty MSE raisesZeroDivisionError and unequal lengths can return misleading0. Normal MSE/MAE/R2 fixture checked.

source_issues.title: Learning and validation curve heuristics
source_issues.detail: High score reasoning assumes higher-is-better; bias/variance diagnosis and adding data are not guarantees. n5 default subset rounds to0 then raisesIndexError. Requested size50 on8-item pool reports50 but actually trains8. Same fixed validation used repeatedly.

source_issues.title: Demo scaling leakage
source_issues.detail: Original regression demo standardizes full X_reg columns before split, contradicting split-first guidance. Finite fixture full mean33.6667 versus train-only.5; no source repair. Executed unchanged demo output is not a clean leakage-free evaluation claim.

source_issues.title: Paired t statistic
source_issues.detail: Code divides variance byK rather thanK-1, inflating nonzero statistic bysqrt(K/(K-1)); fixture ratio1.11803398875 forK5. Overlapping CV training folds violate ordinary independent paired-sample assumptions without further treatment. Fixed df4 threshold requires assumptions; zero std forces t0 even if mean nonzero.

source_issues.title: Toy estimators and demonstrations
source_issues.detail: Clipped sigmoid, online updates, no convergence/input/shape checks. Linear regression divides each online update byn and omits factor2 relative to full squared loss; learning-rate meaning differs from batch MSE. Original seeds/data sizes/100,200,500 epochs unchanged; synthetic single runs are not general benchmarks.

source_issues.title: External library excluded
source_issues.detail: sklearn example not run or installed; source library parity/current defaults unverified. No network, external datasets/models or outputs skill execution. Reviewer did not read or run canonical; only fully read original document blocks used.

source_issues.title: Exercise definitions
source_issues.detail: Average precision is not automatically trapezoidal PR AUC. Nested CV must include inner-fold preprocessing/tuning. Label permutation assesses association under exchangeability; model-comparison difference statistic and finite Monte Carlo p-value convention unstated.100 repeats yield coarse resolution. Exercises not implemented.
